disposition.note: Frozen BUNDLE_META.json is NOT modified. This record supplies the missing semantic labels for a future corrected bundle; both digests are valid but denote different identities.

archive_manifest_file.label: archive_manifest_file
archive_manifest_file.semantics: SHA-256 of the manifest document file itself. Identifies the manifest bytes, not the source tree it enumerates.

archive_source_content_tree.label: archive_source_content_tree
archive_source_content_tree.semantics: Content-tree digest computed from the bytes of SOURCE/ members inside a zip archive. This is the only digest that answers 'what source does this bundle ship?'.

archive_zip_file.label: archive_zip_file
archive_zip_file.semantics: SHA-256 of the archive file itself. Identifies the container bytes, not the tree of its contents.

production_git_head_commit.label: git_head_commit_object
production_git_head_commit.semantics: Git commit object id of HEAD (40 hex). Git object-model identity; not a file-content tree digest.

production_git_head_tree.label: git_head_tree_object
production_git_head_tree.semantics: Git tree object id of HEAD (40 hex). Enumerates git-tracked objects only; excludes dirty working-tree changes and ignores exclusion sets.

rc_working_tree_full_incl_regression.label: working_tree_full_incl_regression
rc_working_tree_full_incl_regression.semantics: Content-tree digest of a working copy using EX_START_BASELINE (regression/ retained). A different scope from the standardized tree.

rc_working_tree_standardized.label: working_tree_standardized
rc_working_tree_standardized.semantics: Content-tree digest of a working copy using EX_STANDARDIZED (regression/ excluded). This is the identity the RC/Sprint 'SOURCE/' bundle trees use.

repository_git_head_commit.label: git_head_commit_object
repository_git_head_commit.semantics: Git commit object id of HEAD (40 hex). Git object-model identity; not a file-content tree digest.

repository_git_head_tree.label: git_head_tree_object
repository_git_head_tree.semantics: Git tree object id of HEAD (40 hex). Enumerates git-tracked objects only; excludes dirty working-tree changes and ignores exclusion sets.

sprint_working_tree_full_incl_regression.label: working_tree_full_incl_regression
sprint_working_tree_full_incl_regression.semantics: Content-tree digest of a working copy using EX_START_BASELINE (regression/ retained). A different scope from the standardized tree.

sprint_working_tree_standardized.label: working_tree_standardized
sprint_working_tree_standardized.semantics: Content-tree digest of a working copy using EX_STANDARDIZED (regression/ excluded). This is the identity the RC/Sprint 'SOURCE/' bundle trees use.

starting_working_tree_baseline.label: starting_working_tree_baseline
starting_working_tree_baseline.semantics: Content-tree digest of the pre-remediation RC working copy recorded by rc_setup.py; baseline for the remediation diff. It is NOT the identity of any shipped archive content.
